description: This file defines the Pagination class within the Opencart Admin Controller Common namespace. It provides methods to generate pagination controls for the admin interface, including handling URL parameters, page calculations, and rendering the pagination view.

classes.name: Pagination
classes.description: A controller class for managing pagination in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates the pagination HTML based on provided settings, including total items, current page, limit, and URL template, and returns the rendered view.
